pages.text: Health 150, Armor 3, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Attack 12, Speed 0.26.$(br)Armed with notes on raising the dead and a necromancer's hoard, you wondered whether an undead body could ever break free of the frailty that comes with rot. A few failed attempts later you found a way to make a truly tough servant - that is where the Mutant Zombie Servant comes from.

Its sturdy frame lets it slam the ground into a seismic wave and throw an uppercut, and it can roar to call in more zombies.$(br)You may also give it a $(item)Soul Jar$(), a $(item)Howling Soul$() or $(item)Berserk Essence$() to $(l:supreme/servants_skills/mutant_zombie_servant)strengthen$() it.$(br)
You can hand your Mutant Zombie Servant armour and weapons, and right-click it with $(item)Rotten Flesh$() to heal it.
